name: Navigate
use: Use for opening another choice level.
notUse: Not for single for selecting a leaf.

name: Single
use: Use for one value in a picker catalogue.
notUse: Not for radio for visible unselected outcomes.

name: Multi
use: Use for independent values with trailing checkboxes.
notUse: Not for single for one value.

name: Radio rows
use: Use for two to four recorded outcomes with visible rings.
notUse: Not for PickerField for five or more outcomes.

name: Radio rows, flat
use: Use for a recorded outcome listed as 60px rows with a line under each inside a form (the sow-death causes).
notUse: Not for a list alone in a drawer or card (radio rows) or five or more outcomes (PickerField).

name: Inline Choice
use: Use for two or three short recorded outcomes.
notUse: Not for radio rows for long labels.

name: Inline Choice · keys
use: Use for a required two or three short outcomes in a form of Stepper rows and Measures, where the answer sits in the same right column (Assisted: No / Yes).
notUse: Not for long labels (radio rows) or an optional answer (an optional row).
